nom: Clinique Clinique Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream

avis.texte: I first bought a very small amount and noticed a very big difference in my dark circles so I decided to buy the normal size and I love it my eyes love it and are looking great this was a very good buy although it's a bit pricy but it's worth it very good purchase
I don't use eye creams a lot and got a small sample of this and loved it! Super hydrating and feels great. Classic clean Clinique smell. I also use the facial cream with SPF. Great stuff!
After using this product for a week, I realized it was causing a allergic reaction on my eyelids, causing them to turn red and swell up.

avis.titre: Bad reaction. Wrecked the skin below my eyes
avis.texte: I love all Clinique products but this. It took me awhile to find out this was what was causing the skin beneath my eyes to break out and become itchy, red, swollen, and painful. Caused major wrinkles and bad reaction due to the allergic reaction

I received this as a sample in my Gift bag. I developed a rash with tiny pustules from it under my eyes. I didn't realize I had Benzoate allergy until using this product, however, I have a lot of allergies and skin sensitivities. Please be aware of all the ingredients in every product if you are similar.

I really wanted to like this eye cream but the benzoate in the cream has caused little blisters under my eyes. I am so disappointed. At one time my dermatologist recommended Clinique because their products were benzoate/benzol free but that is no longer the case. It is just sad.
This is the best ice cream I have ever used! It is worth every penny
I prefer this over many other eye creams! Melts in easily with gentle taps and pats and wake up feeling like the skin around my eyes is nice and moisturized! I recommend giving it a try!

I started using regularly two months ago, morning & night. I can tell a difference on fine lines around my eyes. At almost 64, I've noticed the fine lines popping thru, and this cream definitely gives my skin a big boost.
I never spend this much on cream and after two weeks of using it twice a day, the only thing that I noticed was my checkbook took a hit!
Had such a wonderful time with Ivy at the Daphne AL Ulta!! She really knows her stuff!! She explained everything she put on my face! She's the BEST!!!

I started using this eye cream and love how hydrating it is without feeling greasy. I have very sensitive skin, especially around the eyes, and am pleased to say it doesn't irritate. Would definitely recommend.
I've been using this for about 4 months and I don't see a difference.

avis.titre: mid 40s-my go to cream for wrinkle correction.
avis.texte: I LOVE the Clinique Smart Clinical Repair cream and serum. I can notice a huge difference from when I don't use it to when I do use it. Although it says to apply twice I day, I do so at night and have had great results!

avis.titre: Serious eye irritation-had to seek medical attention
avis.texte: This is my third bottle and it seems to be a problem. The first bottles didn't seem to bother my eye and then I purchased one around Christmas time and my eyes became inflamed, irritated, red, watery, and swollen. I kept thinking it was something else causing it, but once I finally stopped using it, it went away, but I did have to go to a dermatologist to get a steroid cream because my eyes were really inflamed.
This is the best eye cream I've ever used! I use it on my lids as well as under my eyes, and the skin around my eyes has remained firm with no drooping. I use morning and night.
I have tried a lot of eye creams and have sensitivity issues with most. This works great AND doesn't cause any sensitivity. I've already repurchased!
If I hadn't purchased this 50% off I would have returned it. A huge scoop of product was missing from the container. Truly I got my "money's worth" 50% of the product for 50% cost.

This eye cream is great for softening lines and moisturizing the full eye area. I use it close to my bottom water line and above my eyelid, and I haven't had any irritation. I'm not sure if it's had any impact on puffiness or dark circles, but perhaps it will with time. I've been so pleased with the results that I ordered full sizes, even though the mini actually has lasted me awhile while still using it twice a day. I'm excited to see the long term results :)
Eye cream is an absolute must!! Been using since my twenties. I am currently 79 and no one believes my age!!
This eye cream feels so good on my skin, and the results are much better than I could hope for. My dropping and sagging eyes look much better and I look healthier.

I have used other Clinique products with no issue, this one destroyed my eyelids as well as under my eyes! Took me a bit to find that this was the culprit. Once I realized this was the source of my irritated eyes I looked at other 1 star reviews. My eyes and symptoms all mirrored theirs. Once i stopped using my eyes resolved but it was a slow process for them to get back to normal.
This was a birthday gift for my daughter she loves it and noticed how beautifully it works for her.

This product has caused what feels like chemical burns on my skin. The skin is red, raw, swollen, and looks generally strange because of it. Received a sample of this product with one of my orders. When I was trying to save myself from using up my normal eye cream, I tossed this in my gym bag to use in the mornings. After a few uses my eyelids became intolerant to everything, they hurt, stung, have become severely inflammed, and the worst part was I did NOT suspect this product. I trusted Clinique for being hypoallergenic and exclusively have been using their eye makeup products for years because they're safe for eyes. As I head into the holidays depressed by my eye rashes, having spent almost a month with no eye makeup to try and heal my eyes, I've only realized today that the sample jar of this product is the one thing I hadn't accounted for. Opening up the 1-star reviews I now see I'm one of many who has had a terrible reaction to this product. I wouldn't risk it with this one. If you have sensitive skin especially, you're opening the door for a terrible, painful time.
I actually feel like it really works and it lasts a long time!
Totally recommend,I have used it for several years and if I notice the results.

This doesn't even compare to Clinique's Repairwear Laser Focus Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream (which worked GREAT for me). I tried this recently for 3 months and am soooo disappointed. Basically a waste of time and money. If I were you, I'd fire the genius who created your new formula. I've been a Clinique client for decades, but I'll be switching products.
I bought this product for my mom, and she's really happy with it. She says the skin around her eyes looks brighter and the wrinkles have slightly reduced.
Tried this produce, liked it, I have been using all about eyes for several years, I prefer All About Eyes, over this product.

avis.titre: My husband keeps coming back to this
avis.texte: This has been a repeat buy for my husband. He loves how much hydration it gives his under eye area, and is convinced his lines are getting less noticeable.
It has perfect moisturizing effects of my eyes and help them remain soft during the night.

This may be the best eye cream I have ever used. It absorbs into the skin beautifully leaving the eye area feeling refreshed and moisturized, with wrinkles minimized. I give it only 3 stars because of the container shape. Instead of a straight down cylinder it steps outward making it difficult to finish all of the very expensive product. You either have to use your fingernail or some other tool to scrape out product or be resigned to tossing out the jar even though there's at least a couple weeks worth of product left. I will buy it again if Clinique changes the shape of the container to be the same as for its other eye cream products.
I have very sensitive skin and this cream is so gentle around my eyes. And I love the heavy creaminess of it.

Your eyes need this product! Whether you're young or young at heart, this product offers a clean canvas for moisturizer, foundation or whatever comes next. Blurs to a smooth surface making everything you build on top look flawless. A must have.

avis.titre: I would by this product again
avis.texte: This eyecream does everything it promises and is from a trusted company.

I got this because a friend told me she uses and loves it. I am very impressed by how fast it starts working. I have only been using it for about two weeks and already see a big difference. I will continue to buy and use this eye cream.

and I mean nothing! This is THE BEST eye cream out there. I have ran out and used supposedly an equivalent cream and I can tell within a few days the difference. I can see more defined lines and My eyes look tired. The Clinique cream makes My eyes look uplifted and rested.

avis.titre: Not what I was looking for
avis.texte: This is a nice moisturizer w/peptides. Unfortunately I had asked the rep for one with retinol. She looked at this and said it had retinol. I trusted her, however, upon closer look at the ingredients, no retinol. For this price, won't repurchase.
I like Clinique but the prices have really gone up. I will try and find alternatives. I've been using it for years.

I have only been using this product for a couple of weeks and so far so good. I am sensitive to retinol products so I was unsure if this product would be good for me. I use it twice a day and so far no sensitivity. Its creamy and a small amount goes a long way. It leaves my eye area bright and refreshed. Not sure if it is working on my wrinkles yet since I am only using it for a short period of time. I would but this again.
I noticed the result. Small wrinkles disappeared, deeper wrinkles smoothed out a little

Received 2 samples at different times. First time the skin around my eyes became very dry. Second time my eyes are itchy, crusty and dry. So glad these were just samples because it is very difficult to return items for a refund.

avis.titre: Incredibly moisturizing, but provides no lift
avis.texte: I want to love this eye cream, but it does not provide lift for my aging eyes. I do love how it moisturizes and make my eyes feel, but I had to go back to using Repairwear Anti-Gravity eye cream, because after using the Smart Clinical Repair wrinkle correcting eye cream for a couple of weeks, my eyelids and the skin under my eyes were visibly sagging. After returning to the Repairwear Anti-Gravity eye cream, the skin around my eyes is no longer sagging.

59 with dry moderately sensitive skin - I can't use the yellow Dramatically Different at all, nor must if the sunscreen products, so I totally understand the sensitivity concern. I've used exclusively Clinique for decades, and the Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream works great for me! I use just a tiny bit from the end of my eyebrow to my temple and following the bone to just under my eye (but not the tear track area) and concentrating on the 'crows feet' area. Twice a day, usually, and after a month there was a definite improvement! At 59 and until recently an urban desert dweller, I am frequently asked about my skin care and mistaken for a premature grey 30-something.

avis.titre: This is one of my favorite Clinique products
avis.texte: I have sensitive skin and I love that Clinique products are fragrance free and oil free. The eye cream is easy to use, only a small amount is needed and it can be used all around the eye and even the eyelid.

After successful cataract surgery on both my eyes I had problems with wrinkled and crepey skin on both my eyelids and brow bone. It took about 2 months of continued use but my eyes are definitely back to normal. This is my regular eye cream now.
I am in love with this whole product line!!! I have tried several different brands over the years, and I can honestly say that I can see a difference with my skin ( I am on week two)
This product make my eyes itch and my eyes got wrinkled. Not a good product
Great silky smooth texture, I have very sensitive skin and all of clinique eye creams work excellent for me. I am glad I decided to try this one!

I have been using Clinique products for many years. I began using the Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Serum and also the moisturizer two years ago. I love the results I've seen with those products and I decided to order the Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Eye Cream. I decided to use a sample I received while my order was on the way. After the first use I woke up to a rash under my eyes and four days later it is still there. I know it will go away in time but this is not good. I immediately boxed up the jar I ordered and sent it back. I will stick to the other eye products that I've been using All About the Eyes Moisturizer, Antigravity Moisturizer and Repairwear Laser Focus Moisturizer.

avis.titre: Hydrating and Gentle Around the Eyes
avis.texte: This eye cream feels super hydrating and absorbs quickly without being greasy. I've noticed the skin around my eyes looks smoother and a bit brighter after consistent use. It's gentle enough for my sensitive skin, though I haven't seen dramatic wrinkle reduction yet. Still, I'd recommend it for its moisturizing benefits!

avis.titre: Has helped my eyes a lot!
avis.texte: I've been using this for about 2 months now, and I have noticed a difference with my dark circles fading, puffiness is reduced and my fine lines are improving. I will continue to use and I recommend this product.

At first I experienced a slight burning sensation but liked the other results so i kept uses. As i neared the end of my last jar my under eyes became extremely irritated with the cremes use. Not worth the risk of burning my skin.

I love these eye cream it controls the puffiness, fine lines and it moisturize as well to never leaves. Your under eye are dry whenever you apply make up it goes well with that too. I just love it it does the job.
Used at night to help keep wrinkles away from eyelids. Great!

I'm almost 49 but I've been using Clinique products for over a decade, and it sure has paid off! Most people think I'm 36, which is awesome. However, my problem area is around the eyes: my skin is dry, my eyelids are naturally puffy, and wrinkles are starting to appear. I tried Smart Clinical Repair a few years ago...and haven't stopped using it since. It really moisturizes the area and reduces the appearance of wrinkles. I use it after I wash my face and reapply if it's windy or too sunny outside. I love this product and I highly recommend it.
I have oily combination skin, and this eye cream is suitable for me in winter. In summer, it may be a little oily to me

I had been using the clinique all about eyes (the thicker one) and liked it but wanted more to target my wrinkles. After using this for about a month I looked in the mirror and about had a stroke. I had kind of thought my eyes has been looking rough but chalked it up to being parinoid. Nope my wrinkles have gotten way worse and the skin looks so dry. I use this twice a day. Maybe missing a couple times. I am so disappointed in how much damage this caused in only a month. Highly do not recommend.

avis.titre: Very unsatisfied with Clinique  smart clinical repair eye cr
avis.texte: This cream caused my eyes to puff up , right eye had crust. Red upper lids. A lot of itching. Under eyes also became puffed up. Clinique you state your products are hypoallergenic. This product does not appear to be hypoallergenic. I have been a faithful customer for the past 30+ years, and previous products never gave me an allergic reaction. This product " Smarty Clinical Repair Eye Cream" is not hypoallergenic. A week later I'm still fighting with puffy and itching and more pronounce lower lines, which i didn't have.
I got this as a sample and even though I wasn't looking for a new eye cream, I will purchase this again. It's a little pricey, but it conditions my eyes well and doesn't irritate my sensitive skin.
I keep buying this eye cream. Adore it -how it feels going on, and how well it works.

My skin is more sensitive than I thought or this has harsh ingredients. I ran out of my previous eye cream (I think it was called Pep start - it was in an orange tube) and it's no longer offered. I tried this in a sample size and before it ran out, my skin was flaking and uncomfortable.

avis.titre: I would purchase this product when needed.
avis.texte: I love this product. Does help with wrinkles and puffiness of the eyes.

avis.titre: WWWOOOWWW!!! see result right after the first used!!!
avis.texte: I am 53, I use "All About Eyes" for years... lately, wrinkles and lines start showing, so made me to try this product. WOW! I do see the result right after the first used. I used before bed and showed the result the next morning. I am sure will keep this product.
I've been using this eye cream for years. I'm trying to keep the wrinkles at bay! Maybe it works maybe it doesn't. I think it works.
This cream was lovely at first, but after two days of use my eyes began burning, stinging, and watering after use. Terrible.

avis.titre: Dry eyes, blurry vision, pupils dilated!
avis.texte: My eye doctor was shocked that my eyes were so incredibly dry lately that my pupils were dilated and not constricting once I opened them in the morning, apparently that doesn't usually happen. But after removing this from my routine and adding it back, I now know this eye cream is drying out my eyes so much that my eye health is affected. It's such an expensive product too, and makes me bummed bc I am a long time Clinique user and I am having such issues with some of their retinol products. Am I not going to be able to continue to use them as I enter this new phase of life?

avis.titre: Best eye cream and actually works!
avis.texte: I received this in one of the sample bags and I absolutely love it! I have noticed a huge difference compared to all the other creams I have tried. This one actually makes wrinkles look less around my eyes. I pray they never stop making this!
The skin around my eyes LOVES this. Too soon to see how well it works on my crows feet.

I started using Clinique at the age of 14, and am now 62. This was the only brand that was safe for my severely sensitive skin. This cream makes my skin around the eyes very puffy. The swelling doesn't go away during the day. I won't be able to use this treatment, even though I spent too much money on the 3-piece set. Never again.

avis.titre: A definite no for someone with sensitive eyes and skin
avis.texte: I Purchased this when Clinique decided to stop the repairwear line. After a couple nights of using, I noticed that my eyes were a little puffy in the morning when I woke up. As a disclaimer, I have never had puffy eyes. I also noticed that during the day I had to blink a lot as my eyes felt very dry. After a week of using this product, the skin around my eyes became so swollen and red that I stopped using the product all together. I understand that I am probably in the minority, but for someone like me, who has extremely sensitive skin, I could not recommend this

I've tried several Clinique eye products, and for my concern about puffiness in the morning, the best I've used is Smart Clinical Repair. All About Eyes Rich and Repairwear Anti-Gravity are nice moisturizers, but I did not find that they helped with puffiness.

55 F, combination skin with very little wrinkling, thought I would be proactive and start using a retinol eye cream. This caused dry flaky skin all around my eyes. Tried it three times, with at least two to three days in between and each time it caused dry flaky skin. Cannot recommend.
I did noticed my eyes are more hydrated throughout the day. I have one or two lines around my left eye, nothing major but it do work as long as I stay consistent.
I had gotten this as a sample and was worried it was going to leave a sticky residue but it was actually wonderful I will be getting more of this :)
I tried this product as part of a trial package and have come back to buy more. I also like the Moisture Surge under eye product. Both help to reduce puffiness and fine lines

avis.titre: Good moisturizer but still have wrinkles
avis.texte: This is a nice, light, moisturizer for under eyes and on lids. Does not irritate skin. Does it smooth wrinkles? Nah. Not even temporarily.

avis.titre: Why Did I Wait So Long??
avis.texte: I have had a persistent very noticeable puffy eye on the side where I sleep every night. My eye looked terrible -- as though I was unwell, but it was just because I sleep on my side and have straps around my head from a CPAP unit. I tried this eye cream with little hope and this morning I was amazed! My puffy eye is no longer; I mean it is totally normal! What an amazing feat! Clinique, I have been looking at this eye for more than a year and dispairing of doing anything about it. Well, you fixed it for me. I am now going to try all of your Smart line. What have I got to lose but lines and wrinkles.

I'm 56 and have used Clinique products since I was 19. Received this as a sample in a gift pack and decided to give it a try. After using it two nights, I awoke the third morning with irritation under both eyes, little pockets of swollen skin and dark circles were more dark than when I began using this mess. Husband said it looks like I've been on a two day alcohol induced drinking binge. Under eyes are sensitive to touch and overnight I look years older. Hoping irritation goes away in a few days and will stick with my Clinique face moisturizer even for under and around eyes.

I purchased the 6 piece Clinique skin care regimen kit along with another combo and received this as a large sample. I was so excited to try a new eye cream and seemed to be wonderful, until it wasn't! After a few days I started itching under my eyes, with little whelps and small bumps. Tried discontinuing for a couple weeks and reintegrating it, with the same result. Something in this eye cream is very bad for sensitive skin! Avoid!! I've used Clinique for 45+ years but this is terrible. I'm glad it was free but the itching still hasn't subsided - and it's been a few more weeks!

This eye cream gave me red bumps all around my eye area along with burning and irritation after 2 uses. I always choose Clinique for my sensitive skin but this was a fail for me. Returned to the store.

avis.titre: Came back to it in the end; it works the best!
avis.texte: I tried this when it was a beauty steal and it worked really well. I should have stuck with it but i tried a bunch of other cheaper products and got what i paid for… ultimately came back to this and love the reults. I had truly missed it. It works better for my fine lines than my retenoid eye creams. So, I'm stick with thisbinstead of nickle and diming myself on other products.

So I got this as a gift and I tried it for a couple of weeks and didn't see a difference at all. I was so happy that I didn't spend money on this. The clinique repairwear laser focus eye cream works alot better than this.
After toning and applying the wrinkle correcting serum, this is the last step in my nightly routine. Moisturizes, smoothens and brightens my overall eye area.
I love this eye cream and have never had any issues. It works well and is so gentle.
This stuff is horrible!! After putting on the serum I followed with this and it just COMPLETELY PEELED off of my eyes!!Large balls would just roll up like a greasy film!

avis.titre: This made my eyes itch like *crazy*
avis.texte: I've been a Clinique girl for *decades*, and I have never had a Clinique product cause any adverse reaction. One of the main reasons I like and use Clinique is because I have such sensitive skin and it's the only thing I trust. So I'm quite disappointed that this one irritates my eyes and makes them itch so much.

avis.titre: Makes my eyes Red, Swollen, Flaky & Itchy
avis.texte: I started using this product and it inflamed my eyes. I woke up with them severely swollen and inflamed, itchy, burning and flaky. I bought this cream when it was a buy 1 get 1 free. The first jar was fine and didn't inflame my eyes, but this 2nd one is horrible. My eyes were almost burned like a sever sunburn. Not sure if Clinique changed the ingredients but I have to throw this out.

I've been using this for a FULL year now. Immediately helped with dryness. After the first month I could see results- less crepey skin and lighter. By month 3, I gave up using my under eye concealer because I didn't need it any longer. This hydrates and brightens all day. People still ask me to pull out my ID because they can't believe that I'm really 56! Wish I had converted to Clinique years ago!!

I love Clinique and have been a loyal user of their skin care products and makeup for years, since my mom started buying it for me as a teenager. I was excited to try this eye cream based on the rave reviews. Within a few days of starting it, my eyelids and the area around my eyes became red, puffy, dry, and flaky. I immediately stopped using the cream and after a week or two my eyes healed. I thought maybe I just needed to ease into it so I waited a few weeks and then tried again, using it only every few days. Same thing. My eye area is again red and inflamed. I'm wondering if it's an allergic reaction - it seems like others in the comments have had similar issues. Disappointed in this one.
quick to absorb, and tackles wrinkles effectively. I've noticed a visible reduction in fine lines around my eyes.

I tried this cream on one eye for about 10 days, and there was an obvious difference from my other eye! It is so great at reducing wrinkles that I tried it on the rest of my face, and have continued using it (sparingly) on the rest of my face, as this one is matte and wears very nicely under makeup. (I purchased the face cream in this series and it did not work for me.) The eye cream is a big win!

This really works and I even dug into the clinical studies. The Ingredients work and are scientifically proven and well documented. No made up stuff like homeopathic stuff has. Real science. This does and will work. You do apply with fingers. I had no irritation and I do not believe for one moment anyone else did or could have based on ingredients. You should not be putting anything else on or even near the eye area. Just the cream. Creamier creams are lotion based. Those are just hydrating but do nothing real to the skin. This consistency is what is ideal to deliver those ingredients and peptides where they go to actually make change. If you know your skincare you'll be happy. This is a great product.
I immediately got an eyelid twitching reaction from this as well.

I hay noticed a different with puffiness & dark circles. It will take awhile to see results. I have been using for a month. Just because it works well for me doesn't mean it will for the next person. But go ahead & giiot a try.

avis.titre: Seems to work but long term use caused irritation
avis.texte: I love this stuff, I have been using it for about a year now, but 2 months ago, I developed a pulsing eyelid twitch, that only went away after I stopped using this. I can't figure out what ingredient would've caused this, or why. It's the only eye cream I've ever used, I figured at age 39, I'd start focusing on my skin, and my skin is dry, so my eyelids were showing some age... but now I can't use it or my eyelid twitches frequently throughout the day. Super bizarre... persisted for 2 months until I stopped using the cream and now it's dissipating.
I tend to have very loose and saggy skin under my eyes. I love this eye cream and definitely notice a difference under and around my eyes. I'm really glad I tried it.
I just started using this eye cream and I really like it. It is a soft cream that is light weight and nice on the skin. You do not need to use a lot so it will last a long time.

avis.titre: Best eye cream overall, surprisingly great value too
avis.texte: I find this eye cream very nourishing with lasting hydration but not greasy. It actually does the job! This is Cliniques top product in my opinion.
i personally cannot use this product. i was surprised because i had never had an issue with Clinique products.

avis.titre: I'm not seeing what everyone else is talking about!
avis.texte: I'm really puzzled that others find this moisturizing and effective at reducing fine lines. So far it's been very drying around my eyes. It contains whey protein, which many people are slightly allergic to, so maybe that's why it's causing irritation for some.

I'm returning this eye cream after using for few days, my eyes were all itchy and all around the eye area was red and dry with few bumps. I contacted clinique via chat and was able to process the return and they even helped me process another eye cream as a replacement with overnight shipping. This was on Monday and still haven't got, I've reached out Clinique through the chat and even called them and no one cared how desperate I'm with my eyes been so itchy and dry. I got an email confirmation on Monday that my order was placed and shipped, but the tracking number don't give any details as when will be delivered. No one cares about it. I've been using clinique products for over 20 years and never had this experience before. I'll start looking for a better option or company that really cares about our healthy concerns and not only saying rest assure you will get it soon, while I'm experiencing this dryness/itchiness due to their own products. Clinique just don't assume their responsibility here and feeling so frustrated.

avis.titre: I have bought this product many times.
avis.texte: I love this eye cream. I've tried others, but always come back to this one. I haven't found anything cheaper or at the same price point that works this well. I can always start to see more visible lines if I run out or switch to a cheaper eye cream.
Suggested by a friend I know who works in ulta, she has similar skin

This eye cream did absolutely nothing for my middle aged eye area. I am going back to Clinique anti gravity uplifting eye cream which truly lifts and firms and removes my fine lines. I have been really disappointed in Clinique products lately especially with all the silicones and dimethicones they started using in their products. It just dries out the skin. Glycerin and mineral oil is so much better for aging skin.
Doesnt remove or help prevent aging. Is a good undereye moisturizer. I wouldn't put makeup over it 😬

Been using morning and night for the last 5 days but will have to stop due to ongoing eye irritation, tearing and redness. I generally have no issue with Clinique products but will be returning this one.
This is a very good cream, well absorbed and moisturizes. it lasts a long time!

I have always used neuteogena brand for my face care to lomit my budget. But my skin has never been what i wanted. I decided to budge & buy a cleanser, eye cream & moisturizer from clinique & my skin has never been better. It has cleared up (no breakouts), softer, less red. Really love this line! Never going back. These products are genuinely good for your skin.

avis.titre: Does not play well with others
avis.texte: Ive been a decades long fan of Clinique, but these newer formulations are not my davorite. This does not do well under makeup AT ALL. Anytime i try to do makeup over it, it causes complete separation and chaos. Like you can watch it happen. And you cant fix it. Its that bad. I dont hate it otherwise, but its foing to have to be used at night only until its gone. Then im goong to find something else.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again.
avis.texte: I have just started using this product, but love the way it makes my face feel.

avis.titre: First time user and I really love this eye cream.
avis.texte: So glad the consultant recamended this eye cream for me. I absolutely love it and can tell a difference around my eyes already. Skin is much softer
I have used this eye cream for about a year now and love it. I love the texture, and a little goes a long way. I would definitely recommend it.

This eye cream firms and moisturizes the skin around my eyes. I can feel the differences as soon as I put it on. I've used Clinique's other eye creams for years and they are great, but I may be upgrading to this product, now in my senior years.
